## Summary

The knowledge graph returned 28 BRCA1 sequence variants from ClinVar and three associated disease concepts, but it did not return a gene record, genetic tests, or key literature for this query. The variants span missense substitutions across the BRCA1 coding sequence, and the disease associations include hereditary breast ovarian cancer syndrome, hereditary cancer-predisposing syndrome, and familial breast-ovarian cancer susceptibility 1 [2][4][12].
